The '''Coruscant Naval Base''' was one of many massive naval bases on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the base was known as '''Imperial City Naval Base''', abbreviated '''ICNB'''.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the base was a massive staging area for the loading and unloading of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] forces. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], witnessing the first wave of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] launching from the landing platforms at the base and carrying [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to fight the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], remarked on the beginning of the Clone Wars. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], alongside [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], oversaw the launching of these vessels from a nearby balcony.

After the fall of the Republic and its reorganization into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the base became the location of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] school. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] school was commanded for a time by the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Vindoo Barvel]].
